card.name: Words leading into risk or monitoring statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words or partway-through-word pieces just before an adverse-effect or monitoring term, e.g. 'risk of', 'increase the', or inside a long medical term. Seen in warnings sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Linking word before risk
modes.description: 'of' or 'the' right after 'risk' or 'increase' and before an adverse reaction.
modes.example: Administration of fondaparinux sodium injection earlier than 6 hours after surgery increases the risk<< of>> major bleeding.
